title: Data Checklist: On Unit-Testing Datasets with Usable Information

bias_targets.methodology: Using the V-information framework (specifically applicability and insufficiency tests) to measure whether specific offensive or profane words contain all the usable information for predicting hate speech labels and model safety preferences.

Applying applicability, sufficiency, and exclusivity tests using conditional V-information to determine if the difference in word count between two responses acts as an annotation artifact that predicts human or model preference.

Conducting a non-exclusivity test based on V-information to evaluate whether English monolingualism is the exclusive driver of preference in a multilingual alignment dataset (UltraFeedback), rendering non-English components uninformative.
